facts.business: Goodricke Group Limited is engaged in the cultivation, production, and sale of tea across its gardens in Assam, Dooars, and Darjeeling regions of India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Operation 25 Quintals initiative aims to achieve yields of 2,500 kgs per hectare in all future young tea plantations.

auditor.name: M/s. M S K A & Associates LLP, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Climatic uncertainties and changing crop patterns across major tea growing regions
Pest related challenges and upsurge in pest activities even in non-traditional belts of Assam causing loss of high value crop
Excessive dependence on the domestic market limiting the industry's ability to consistently realize remunerative prices
Industry competitiveness due to excessive dependence on the domestic market
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into by the Company with related parties during the year under review were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business and are in compliance with the applicable provisions of the Act and the Listing Regulations. There are no materially significant related party transactions that may have potential conflict with interest of the Company at large.
